heard: An astronaut ruined NASA's first lunar color camera within minutes. Millions watched, expecting live color footage of the Apollo 12 moonwalk. Astronaut Alan Bean accidentally pointed the camera lens directly into the sun. Intense solar light burned out the camera's sensitive tube instantly. The live video feed to Earth went black almost immediately. Bean tried fixing the Space Age camera by hitting it with his hammer. The low-tech repair failed, leaving NASA with only still photographs. The Space Age camera never broadcast another frame.
